g.title: Fetches and mutates through route handlers with TanStack Query. The timezone lanes use dnd-kit and call the reassign route on drop. Realtime hooks only invalidate the query cache.
Posts issue and pull request events. The route recomputes the HMAC-SHA256 signature with a timing-safe compare before it marks linked tasks done or reopens them.
The shift-brief route sends the caller's tasks updated in the last 24 hours or 7 days as a prompt and relays the response as server-sent events, with a 15 second timeout.
Runs on page routes only, not on /api. Refreshes the Supabase session cookie and redirects signed-out visitors from /dashboard, /tasks, /analytics and /settings to /login.
Call getAuthUser(), then read tasks through Prisma with the same creator-or-assignee filter as the API, so the first render already has data.

Every handler verifies the user with Supabase, validates input with Zod and scopes task queries to the creator or assignee. The bulk route runs updateMany and the audit createMany in one prisma.$transaction.
Email and password plus GitHub OAuth. The demo sign-in creates its user with the service role key on first use, then seeds a workspace with fixed ids and skip-duplicates.

Tasks, task events, notifications, users, handoff templates, GitHub tokens and Slack installations. Composite indexes on assignee and creator with updatedAt back the dashboard query. Queries use the pooled URL, migrations the direct URL.
Task and notification changes arrive as signals. Payloads carry no joined rows, so each event invalidates the query cache and the client refetches the full shape from the API.
